# The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
The story centers on Arthur Dent, a hapless Englishman who is rescued from Earth's destruction by Ford Prefect, an alien researcher for the eponymous guidebook. Earth was revealed to be a giant supercomputer, designed by another supercomputer, Deep Thought, to calculate the "Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Everything," the answer to which was "42." Dent and his companions, including Zaphod Beeblebrox and Trillian, travel to The Restaurant at the End of the Universe before embarking on further adventures.
The material has spawned numerous adaptations. A six-episode radio series, known as the "Fits" series, first aired on BBC Radio 4 in 1978, with Peter Jones narrating the guide. This led to a six-episode television series in 1981. The novels, described as a "trilogy in five parts," include *The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy* , *The Restaurant at the End of the Universe* , *Life, the Universe and Everything* , *So Long, and Thanks for All the Fish* , and *Mostly Harmless* . These books have also been adapted into audiobooks and comic book series. Furthermore, a film adaptation was released in 2005, and a later television series for Hulu was announced in 2019.
